source.purpose: Reproduce whether Rust process-environment writes and removals are visible to the actual current C-core early-prefill flag reader. No model or GPU work; unchanged core compiled with the server build flags and linked to a Rust caller.

official_sources.finding: getenv reads the CRT environment copy.
The inspected version implements setenv using SetEnvironmentVariableW.

spec.model: none; actual C core flag reader called from Rust
spec.generated_command_text:
@echo off
call "D:\BuildTools\Common7\Tools\VsDevCmd.bat" -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 11
cl /nologo /std:c11 /O2 /W4 /DQRT_STATIC /D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS /c /I"D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\native\src" "D:\projects\windows-runtime-environment-probe-r1.c" /Fo"D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\build\windows-runtime-environment-probe-build-r1\probe.obj"
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 12
cl /nologo /std:c11 /O2 /W4 /DQRT_STATIC /D_CRT_SECURE_NO_WARNINGS /c /I"D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\native\src" "D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\native\src\qwen36_baseline.c" /Fo"D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\build\windows-runtime-environment-probe-build-r1\baseline.obj"

"C:\Users\sshuser\.cargo\bin\rustc.exe" --edition=2021 --crate-name windows_runtime_environment_probe -C opt-level=2 -C "link-arg=D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\build\windows-runtime-environment-probe-build-r1\probe.obj" -C "link-arg=D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\build\windows-runtime-environment-probe-build-r1\baseline.obj" -C link-arg=/STACK:268435456 "D:\projects\windows-runtime-environment-probe-r1.rs" -o "D:\projects\AIMA-public-tokenizer-cache-20260915\build\windows-runtime-environment-probe-build-r1\windows-runtime-environment-probe.exe"

finding: The actual unchanged qrt_qwen36_whole_provider_early_prefill_stream_enabled reader returns disabled after the first Rust assignment to1, before any explicit CRT environment access in the test. Further Rust assignment, override and removal leave the C copy stale. Using _putenv_s in the same C object makes the real core reader and Rust process environment agree.
scope: This reproduces a Windows configuration handoff bug with the actual existing C core compiled using the server C flags and linked to Rust1.95.0. It does not load the model, execute HIP, explain the CLI/HTTP timing difference by itself, or invalidate token/logit comparisons already captured for the existing service.
required_followup: Apply runtime profile and explicit overrides through the same C runtime during service startup, verify the native reader and process values agree, then rerun actual HTTP numerical and protocol boundaries.
